question: 各州订单量排名
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM olist_orders_dataset o JOIN olist_customers_dataset c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY order_count DESC
rationale: 订单量必须 COUNT DISTINCT order_id，客户地域通过 orders→customers 连接。

question: 各品类销售额排名
sql: SELECT t.product_name_english, SUM(i.price) AS sales_revenue FROM olist_order_items_dataset i JOIN olist_products_dataset p ON i.product_id=p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name=t.product_category_name GROUP BY t.product_name_english ORDER BY sales_revenue DESC
rationale: 商品销售额按订单明细 price 聚合，品类要经 products 和 translation 映射。

question: 各流派收入排名
sql: SELECT g.Name AS genre, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS revenue FROM chinook.InvoiceLine il JOIN chinook.Track t ON il.TrackId=t.TrackId JOIN chinook.Genre g ON t.GenreId=g.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC
rationale: Chinook 收入使用 InvoiceLine 的 UnitPrice×Quantity，必须显式限定表别名避免 UnitPrice 歧义。

question: Olist 各品类的销售额排名（显示英文品类名）
sql:
SELECT pcm.product_name_english AS category_name,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales_amount
FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi
JOIN olist_products_dataset p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN product_category_name_translation pcm ON p.product_category_name = pcm.product_category_name
GROUP BY pcm.product_name_english
ORDER BY sales_amount DESC
rationale: Bad Case 闭环修复：经三级 Schema 检索 + SQL 守卫验证。

question: Chinook 各流派的曲目数量排名
sql:
SELECT chinook.Genre.Name AS genre_name, COUNT(*) AS track_count
FROM chinook.Track
JOIN chinook.Genre USING(GenreId)
GROUP BY chinook.Genre.Name
ORDER BY track_count DESC
rationale: Bad Case 闭环修复：经三级 Schema 检索 + SQL 守卫验证。
